author: Fixture Reporter
content:
Apple and Nvidia have announced a joint workshop for game developers in December. Sessions will cover graphics profiling, rendering workflows and techniques for identifying performance bottlenecks.

The workshop will include demonstrations and practical exercises for participating developers. Registration will open before the event, and the organizers will publish a detailed session schedule.

The program is an educational event for game-development teams.
headline: Apple And Nvidia Announce December GPU Graphics Workshop For Game Developers
summary: Apple and Nvidia plan a joint game-development workshop focused on graphics profiling and rendering techniques.
